topic: Asking the Electronics Desk about Mounting a New TV

script.title: AT THE ELECTRONICS DESK
script.scene_zh: 電器賣場 · 詢問壁架
script.story_hook: He wants the big TV up on his wall.
script.intro_zh: 他想把那台大電視掛到家裡的牆壁上。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to our electronics desk today. Listen for handy shopping questions.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的電器櫃台。留意實用的購物提問。
script.outro: And that's a smart mount plan. Watch the tape test, then decide.
script.outro_zh: 一套聰明的懸掛方案就這樣定好了。先做膠帶測試，再慢慢決定。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged man in his late forties with short greying salt-and-pepper hair combed to one side, thin reading glasses, a navy blue quilted vest over a light grey long-sleeve shirt, dark jeans, and a broad heavy-set build
script.char_b_description: a cheerful young woman in her twenties with shoulder-length straight auburn hair tucked behind one ear, small hoop earrings, a bright teal store polo shirt with a name tag, black slacks, and a slim athletic build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm thinking about mounting this TV.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈmaʊntɪŋ ðɪs ˌtiːˈviː/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我在考慮把這台電視掛起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome! What size is the screen?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm wʌt saɪz ɪz ðə skrin/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎！請問螢幕要多大？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty-five inches, still in the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti faɪv ˈɪntʃəz stɪl ɪn ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 六十五吋，還裝在箱子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, then you'll need the big mount kit.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðən jul nid ðə bɪɡ maʊnt kɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，那你需要這套大號的壁架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The big one? How do I know it holds?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ wʌn haʊ du aɪ noʊ ɪt hoʊldz/
dialogue.zh: 大的那種？怎麼知道撐不撐得住？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each kit lists a weight limit right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ kɪt lɪsts ə weɪt ˈlɪmət raɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 每組都寫了承重上限，就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, this says up to a hundred pounds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðɪs sɛz ʌp tə ə ˈhʌndɹəd paʊndz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這上面寫到一百磅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That fits you with room to spare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt fɪts ju wɪθ ɹum tə spɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那完全夠用，還有富餘呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Does it fit any wall, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd dʌz ɪt fɪt ˈɛni wɔl ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。是不是什麼牆面都裝得上去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, but you want a stud behind the drywall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli bʌt ju wɑt ə stʌd bɪˈhɑɪnd ðə ˈdɹaɪwɔl/
dialogue.zh: 大致可以，不過螺絲要鎖在壁柱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A stud... um, what exactly is that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stʌd ʌm wʌt ɪɡˈzæktli ɪz ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 壁柱……嗯，那到底是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the wood beam inside the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə wʊd bim ɪnˈsaɪd ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 就是牆壁裡面那根木頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I see, so screws go in wood.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ si soʊ skɹuz ɡoʊ ɪn wʊd/
dialogue.zh: 喔，我懂了，螺絲要鎖進木頭裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, that's what holds all the weight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ðæts wʌt hoʊldz ɔl ðə weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，整台電視的重量全靠它撐住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my wall might be hollow in spots.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt maɪ wɔl maɪt bi ˈhɑloʊ ɪn spɑts/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我的牆有些位置可能是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We sell a stud finder for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɛl ə stʌd ˈfaɪndɚ fɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 那種壁柱偵測器我們就有賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A finder? Does it actually work well?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfaɪndɚ dʌz ɪt ˈæktʃuəli wɝk wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 偵測器？它掃起來準不準？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pretty well, it beeps near the wood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɹɪti wɛl ɪt bipz nɪɹ ðə wʊd/
dialogue.zh: 滿準的，靠近木頭就會嗶一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Can you help me mount it too?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs kən ju hɛlp mi maʊnt ɪt tu/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那裝的時候能麻煩你搭把手？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do install service for a flat fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du ɪnˈstɔl ˈsɝvəs fɚ ə flæt fi/
dialogue.zh: 我們提供上門安裝，統一收一個費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A flat fee? How much is that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə flæt fi haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 統一價？那要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety for a standard wall mount job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti fɚ ə ˈstændəɹd wɔl maʊnt dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 標準牆面安裝，九十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety? Hmm, that's more than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti həm ðæts mɔɹ ðæn aɪ θɔt/
dialogue.zh: 九十？嗯，比我原本想的多一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, but we bring all the tools.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ bʌt wi bɹɪŋ ɔl ðə tuls/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，不過工具我們全都帶過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, I've got no drill at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu aɪv ɡɑt noʊ dɹɪl æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 說實話，我家裡連電鑽都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, and a tech clears the whole box too.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ænd ə tɛk klɪɹz ðə hoʊl bɑks tu/
dialogue.zh: 你看，技師還會順手幫你清走空箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that part sounds really nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt pɑɹt saʊndz ˈɹɪli naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 喔，這一項聽起來真不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When can they come out? Tomorrow, maybe?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn kən ðeɪ kʌm aʊt təˈmɑɹoʊ ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 他們哪天能上門？明天方便不方便？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow works, is that morning or afternoon?
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑɹoʊ wɝks ɪz ðæt ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ɔɹ ˌæftɚˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 明天可以，是上午還是下午？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You pick the window, they call first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju pɪk ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ðeɪ kɔl fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 時段你挑，出發前他們會打電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. So about the ports... how many HDMI?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt soʊ əˈbaʊt ðə pɔɹts haʊ ˈmɛni eɪtʃdiːɛmˈaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。講到螢幕接孔，有幾個HDMI？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This model has four HDMI ports on back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈmɑdəl hæz fɔɹ eɪtʃdiːɛmˈaɪ pɔɹts ɑn bæk/
dialogue.zh: 這一台後面有四個HDMI孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four? Plenty for my box and console.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ ˈplɛnti fɚ maɪ bɑks ænd ˈkɑnsoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 四個？機上盒跟遊戲主機都夠用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one port is eARC for a soundbar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn pɔɹt ɪz ˈiˌɑɹk fɚ ə ˈsaʊndˌbɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 其中一個是eARC，專門接音響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soundbar? I'll add that maybe next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaʊndˌbɑɹ aɪl æd ðæt ˈmeɪbi nɛkst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 音響？我先不加，下個月再來買。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart budget move. Anything else on the TV?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈbʌdʒɪt muv ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls ɑn ðə ˌtiːˈvi/
dialogue.zh: 很會安排。關於電視，還有哪裡要確認？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, if it's too big, can I return it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɪf ɪts tu bɪɡ kən aɪ rɪˈtɝn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那要是太大呢？是不是還能退？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, thirty days, keep the receipt handy.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈθɝɾi deɪz kip ðə ɹɪˈsit ˈhændi/
dialogue.zh: 可以，三十天內，收據留好就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I'll need the giant box back, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt aɪl nid ðə ˈdʒaɪənt bɑks bæk ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 但我得把那台大箱子裝回去，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, box plus all the packing foam.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈɹɛkt bɑks plʌs ɔl ðə ˈpækɪŋ foʊm/
dialogue.zh: 對，箱子加上所有泡棉都得留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, I always lose that foam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ aɪ ˈɔlweɪz lus ðæt foʊm/
dialogue.zh: 天，我每次都把泡棉弄丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save a bag for it, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ə bæɡ fɚ ɪt ˈsɪɹiəsli/
dialogue.zh: 留個袋子收起來嘛，說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll try. Could you measure it for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl traɪ kʊd ju ˈmɛʒɚ ɪt fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 我試試看。能麻煩你幫我量一下尺寸？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, sixty-five inches wide, thirty tall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ˈsɪksti faɪv ˈɪntʃəz waɪd ˈθɝɾi tɔl/
dialogue.zh: 好，寬六十五吋，高三十吋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's huge for my little living room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts hjudʒ fɚ maɪ ˈlɪɾɚ ˈlɪvɪŋ ɹum/
dialogue.zh: 對我小小的客廳來說也太大了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try paper on the wall, see how it feels.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹaɪ ˈpeɪpɚ ɑn ðə wɔl si haʊ ɪt filz/
dialogue.zh: 先拿紙貼在牆上，感覺一下大小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brilliant, like a life-size TV shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɹɪliənt laɪk ə ˈlaɪf saɪz ˌtiːˈvi ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 太妙了，就像等大的電視輪廓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have tape rolls at the front desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv teɪp roʊlz æt ðə frʌnt dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 前面櫃台就有美紋紙膠帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll grab a roll, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪl ɡɹæb ə roʊl θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我去拿一卷，謝啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, are we buying the TV today?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɑɹ wi ˈbaɪɪŋ ðə ˌtiːˈvi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那麼今天這台電視就買下去了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, plus the big mount kit and finder.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌs ðə bɪɡ maʊnt kɪt ænd ˈfaɪndɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對，再加上大號壁架和偵測器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice. Card or a store credit line?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs kɑɹd ɔɹ ə stɔɹ ˈkɹɛdɪt laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好。刷卡，還是走店內分期？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, and can I get the receipt emailed?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd ænd kən aɪ ɡɛt ðə ɹɪˈsit ˈimeɪld/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡。收據可以寄到我的信箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Emailed is easy, what's your email?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈimeɪld ɪz ˈizi wʌts jʊɹ ˈimeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 寄信很方便，你的信箱是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's long... I'll say it, you type.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts lɔŋ aɪl seɪ ɪt ju taɪp/
dialogue.zh: 信箱有點長……我唸，你慢慢打。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, check your inbox in a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt tʃɛk jɔɹ ˈɪnbɑks ɪn ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，收件匣一下就會出現。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for not rushing me today.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ nɑt ˈɹʌʃɪŋ mi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你今天都沒有催我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Good luck with that big wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm ɡʊd lʌk wɪð ðæt bɪɡ wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，祝你掛牆一切順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll text you if the studs hide.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tɛkst ju ɪf ðə stʌdz haɪd/
dialogue.zh: 要是壁柱太難找，我再傳訊息問你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I'll keep my phone close. Bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl kip maɪ foʊn kloʊs baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我會留意手機，再見！

script.youtube_title: 【電器行壁架📺】「我總弄丟那塊泡棉」教你挑大電視＋懸掛套裝🎧🛒｜聽完就敢自己問｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Mounting a New TV
script.youtube_title_en: "I Always Lose That Foam" — Mounting a Big TV at the Electronics Desk
script.youtube_description:
「我總是弄丟那塊泡棉」——想在家裡掛上大電視，走到電器櫃台卻不知該從哪裡問起？這一集用 60 句連續的真實對話，帶你從挑壁架、確認承重、詢問安裝服務，一路聽到退貨規則與結帳。

你會聽到：怎麼問壁架尺寸與承重上限；「壁柱」到底是什麼、偵測器掃起來準不準；上門安裝的價格與時段怎麼約；螢幕後面有幾個 HDMI、eARC 怎麼接音響；還有萬一買太大，三十天退貨要留哪些東西。

整段都是 A2 初級單字與美國人日常真正會用的短句：um、well、so、hmm、ha。聽完你就敢自己開口：Does it fit...、Can you help me、How much is that、Can I return it。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，先聽兩遍，再大聲跟讀一遍，讓耳朵和嘴巴一起記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"I always lose that foam" — you finally bought the big TV, but the wall-mount kit at the electronics desk feels impossible to ask about. This 60-line immersive listening practice walks you through the whole trip, from picking the right kit to booking the install.

You will hear: asking about size and weight limits, what a wall stud is and how a finder works, the flat fee and time window for home install, HDMI and eARC port questions, and the 30-day return rule when the TV turns out too big.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the small talk Americans really use: um, well, so, hmm, ha. By the end you'll own lines like Does it fit..., Can you help me, How much is that, and Can I return it.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧電視壁架英文｜挑尺寸・約安裝・問退貨｜大電視掛牆不慌張｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
難得買了一台大電視，走到電器櫃台卻不知道該先問什麼，怎麼辦？壁架要挑哪個尺寸、能不能撐住重量？上門安裝要多少錢、又要怎麼約時間？

這一集帶你走進一家電器賣場，從詢問壁架、確認承重、搞懂牆裡的「壁柱」，一路聽到安裝報價、螢幕接孔、退貨規則與結帳，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📺 問尺寸：Sixty-five inches, still in the box.
🔧 問安裝：We do install service for a flat fee.
🔌 問接孔：So about the ports... how many HDMI?
🧾 問退貨：Well, if it's too big, can I return it?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、hmm 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，只要跟著這趟櫃台對話走一趟，下次自己走進電器行，話就會從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你新家的那面牆，掛得又穩又好看。
script.thumbnail_action: holding a wall-mount kit up beside a big TV box
